subject: Rate harmonization amendment & billing-buckets crosswalk
messages:
From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@treelinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Grant <joel.grant@treelinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: MSA redline + billing buckets crosswalk for upcoming order form

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward but Legal and Finance have flagged two items that need to be reconciled before procurement can issue a PO: a) Treeline's MSA redlines (see attached) and b) a clear crosswalk between Redwood's billing "buckets" (throughput/embedding/streams) and the line items on the Order Form so our FP&A can model spend for Q1.

Two asks: can your legal team provide a short amendment that 1) harmonizes rates across the Order Form and MSA definitions and 2) spells out a proration / effective-dates approach for mid-quarter capacity adjustments? If possible, we'd like a draft in the next 3 business days — our executive sponsor (Joel) is prioritizing this for November close.

Attaching: MSA_redline_Treeline_v2.docx

Thanks,
Alicia Romero
Procurement Manager, Treeline Health
Alicia.Romero@treelinehealth.com
(415) 555-0134
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@treelinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline + billing buckets crosswalk for upcoming order form

Alicia — thanks for the note and for sending Treeline's redlines. Looping in Laura (Legal), Connor (Finance) and Marissa (Solutions) to help drive a short-form amendment rather than reopening the full MSA. Quick points:

- We can produce a targeted "Rate Harmonization Exhibit" that sits alongside the MSA/Order Form and maps Redwood billing buckets to Order Form line items. That should address FP&A modelling.
- For proration, Finance prefers a standard calendar-day pro rata (effective date -> next invoice) but we can include a mechanism for negotiated mid-quarter true-ups for larger top-ups.
- We will review Treeline's redline and call out any high-risk clauses (data residency, audit window, indemnity carve-outs).

Laura/Connor/Marissa — can you take the Treeline MSA redline and convert our response into: 1) a two-page commentary + proposed amendment language (to be appended as an exhibit), and 2) a simple one-sheet crosswalk (xlsx) mapping their requested line items to our buckets? Alicia prefers to review by end-of-day Friday (27th).

Next steps: I'll coordinate an internal redline triage this afternoon and send a proposed exhibit draft by Thursday EOD.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline + billing buckets crosswalk for upcoming order form

Karthik — quick update from Legal after an initial pass on Treeline's redline. Attached is commentary that: (a) accepts their simpler SLA language with one modification on the remedies cap; (b) rejects a perpetual audit window and proposes a 12-month lookback (we can make this 24 months during pilot but prefer bounded scope); and (c) proposes to satisfy their "billing parity" ask via an Exhibit rather than rewriting core indemnities. See the inline highlights in Redwood_MSA_commentary_karthik_v1.docx.

I drafted suggested Exhibit language for rate harmonization that:
- Maps our internal buckets to three Order Form line items (Throughput, Embeddings, Streaming),
- Defines "Effective Adjustment Date" as the date an amendment is executed, with proration computed on calendar days, and
- Adds a clause for discrete top-ups over $100k to carry an optional negotiated true-up within 30 days.

Please review the attached and let me know if Finance has any objections to the $100k threshold or to calendar-day proration. If we have alignment, I can convert the exhibit to Word for signature-ready insertion.

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_commentary_karthik_v1.docx

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@treelinehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Joel Grant <joel.grant@treelinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline + billing buckets crosswalk for upcoming order form

Karthik/Team — appreciate the fast turnaround. We reviewed Laura's commentary and 90% of this looks good to Treeline. Two items from our side:

1) The $100k top-up threshold: Joel (CFO) wants that lowered to $50k because our spike risk model is different during a pilot.
2) We need explicit language about how consumption credits are handled if a top-up is cancelled within 14 days of execution — specifically a refund vs. credit option for Treeline's accounting team.

Attached is an updated OrderForm-v5.pdf with our preferred line-item labels; I highlighted the fields we'd like the Exhibit crosswalk to reference. If you can produce the Exhibit draft with the $50k threshold and the cancellation-handling options, we can route to Joel for final sign-off.

Attachment: OrderForm-v5.pdf

Would you also include a simple sample invoice row in the crosswalk so our billing team can map to our ERP? That will help speed procurement.

Regards,
Alicia
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@treelinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: MSA redline + billing buckets crosswalk for upcoming order form

Alicia — thanks, good notes. Summary of what we'll deliver by EOD tomorrow (Tuesday):

1) Draft Rate Harmonization Exhibit (Word) that: maps our billing buckets to Treeline Order Form line items, includes a sample invoice row, and sets the top-up threshold to $50k per Treeline's request.
2) Cancellation handling language with two options (refund within 14 days OR account credit) and a recommendation to default to credit unless Treeline explicitly requests a refund.
3) Signed-off commentary file for Legal to attach to the amendment, and an editable xlsx crosswalk (Rate-Harmonization-Exhibit-draft.xlsx).

Operational note: to avoid a full MSA re-open, this will be a narrowly-scoped amendment/exhibit referencing the existing MSA and Order Form. If Treeline confirms the credit vs refund default now, we can issue a DocuSign-ready envelope for Joel's signature immediately after you confirm.

Proposed incentive (to help close this month): Redwood will apply a one-time 10% ramp credit on consumed tokens for the first 30 days post-execution (applies only to throughput usage, not embeddings). If that looks OK, we'll add the credit clause into the exhibit.

Link to DocuSign envelope (will be populated once exhibit is attached): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-rateharmonize

Next steps: Alicia, please confirm preferred cancellation handling ("refund" or "credit") and whether you accept the 10% ramp credit. Once you confirm, Laura will convert the exhibit to signature-ready Word and I'll circulate the DocuSign.

Thanks — Karthik
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
